title: AutoGG's
description: A mod that sends GG's in chat after every game.
body:
# **This Mod Requires YetAnotherConfigLib and Mod Menu to reach it's fullest Capability**
# 
AutoGG's is a mod that detects when a person dies and automatically sends the message in chat "GG's". This mod includes customisation including editing the servers the mod works on. This mod helps improve sportsmanship and respectuful play and is great when you can't be bothered to type GG's every round. **Make sure you set servers GG's will work on in the AutoGG's mod menu config.**

###  **Thank you for using AutoGGs!**
